description: See why each pull request is stuck, and get it unstuck, without leaving bb. My PRs lists your pull requests, review requests for you and your teams, the ones you reviewed, and assigned ones by repository, each with its +/- lines and led by what blocks it: failing CI down to the job, changes requested, unresolved comments, conflicts or a stack. Reviewed turns amber when the author pushes after your review. Open one for its reviewers and their verdicts, labels, and tabs: Overview (the description, then comments and reviews), Checks with error annotations, Files with syntax-highlighted diffs and review threads under their lines, Commits with the ones since your review marked, and Comments. Edit the title and description, comment on a line or range, reply, delete your own comments, submit a review, mark your draft ready, and close or reopen, each only when you click. A menu links the PR to a bb thread, asks about it, explains it, or sends every finding to an agent, starting in the PR's project; Fix with agent does it for one comment or failed job. Jira keys open in bb's My Jira plugin. Search, hide or fold repositories, move by keyboard, switch gh accounts, and get alerts when CI fails or someone comments. Uses the GitHub CLI login or a token; github.com only.
